run_documentation_generator: run the m.css Python documentation generator with a config file to generate HTML docs
crawl_module: crawl a Python module to extract its classes, functions, enums, and data members into a name map
render_module: render a Python module's documentation page using Jinja2 templates and extracted docstrings
extract_function_doc: extract function documentation including parameters, return types, and docstrings from a Python function
build_search_data: build a trie-based search index from crawled Python symbols for full-text documentation search
